[[Private/Legends|Private]] '''Mesloto''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She was present in the [[Strike Base XR-484|Imperial Command Center]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] during the Empire's [[Invasion of Ossus|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
